class.name: NetwPersistence
class.brief_description: One [NetwEntity]'s saved record, reached as [member NetwEntity.persistence].

method.name: load
method.description: Reads the stored record and applies it to the configured properties. The promise returns [code]true[/code] when a record was found, and [code]false[/code] when none was stored and the properties keep their values. A failed load fails the promise, and [method NetwPromise.wait] returns the code. On a node from [method Netw.spawn], awaiting it before [method Node.add_child] adds the node with its stored values. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴ERR_UNCONFIGURED no persistence, unopened database or missing migration ┠╴ERR_UNAUTHORIZED this peer is not the server ┠╴ERR_BUSY a save is pending, properties have unsaved changes, ┃ changed during loading or too many operations are pending ┠╴ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST a configured node was freed during loading ┠╴ERR_FILE_UNRECOGNIZED unknown save format or a newer saved version ┠╴ERR_INVALID_DATA saved property names or types differ ┠╴ERR_UNAVAILABLE the database closed or the session ended during loading ┖╴storage error storage could not read the record [/codeblock] [b]Server Only.[/b]

method.name: save
method.description: Writes the configured properties as this [NetwEntity]'s record. The promise returns [code]false[/code] when nothing had changed. A failed save fails the promise, and [method NetwPromise.wait] returns the code. The [NetwEntity] stays [member dirty] so the next save tries again. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴ERR_UNCONFIGURED no persistence configuration or unopened database ┠╴ERR_UNAUTHORIZED this peer is not the server ┠╴ERR_BUSY a save is pending, the spawn load has not succeeded, ┃ or the database has too many pending operations ┠╴ERR_INVALID_DATA configured values have wrong types or storage gave no result ┠╴ERR_UNAVAILABLE the nodes were freed, server authority changed or the ┃ database closed. The write may still have reached storage ┖╴storage error storage refused or could not complete the write [/codeblock] [b]Server Only.[/b]

members.member: The name of the [NetwDatabase] this record lives in. Set by [method NetwPersistenceConfig.database].
Whether any configured property differs from what was last saved.
The id this record is stored under. Supplied by [method NetwPersistenceConfig.record_id].

The read-only saved property definition for [method NetwDatabase.read] and [method NetwDatabase.write]. [code]null[/code] until persistence is ready on the server. Direct database calls do not update the root's properties or [member dirty].

signal.name: loaded
signal.description: Emitted when a load finishes, including the one [method NetwPersistenceConfig.load_on_spawn] starts. [param found] is [code]false[/code] when no record was stored for [member record_id].

signal.name: saved
signal.description: Emitted when a save is stored.
